description: Paid endpoint ($0.005): cross-venue funding carry for 1-20 symbols (Hyperliquid + OKX; Binance/Bybit when reachable). Rates normalized to hourly/APR; spread = max-min. <2 venues or bad params return an error and no charge. Returns x402 requirements + URL. Free sample: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/funding-spread
name: get_funding_spread
title: Funding spread (paid, x402) — $0.005

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
